raw_graphql_pull_request.body: Contributed by **Krai Ltd.** (hasith@krai.ai) as part of its MLPerf Endpoints v1.0 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash submission on 8x AMD Instinct MI300X; this commit is one of the patches disclosed in that submission. mxfp4_round_up_hidden_size_and_intermediate_size pads the per-partition intermediate size of the AITER_TRITON_MXFP4_BF16 backend to a multiple of 256 through the generic ROCm arm. That alignment is not something the kernel asks for: aiter's Triton moe_gemm_a16w4 masks K tails (EVEN_K / MASK_K_LIMIT) and N tails (wrapped loads, masked stores) itself, so its only hard alignment is the 32-wide e8m0 scale block, and both tail paths are already exercised in production by gpt-oss on gfx942 (2880 -> 2944 per partition at TP1). The padded columns are zero weights with zero scales and contribute nothing to either GEMM. The over-padding is expensive for narrow shards: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (moe_intermediate 2304) at TP4 is 576 -> 768 (+33 % expert weight bytes streamed per rank) and at TP8 288 -> 512 (+78 %). With a 128 alignment the same shards become 640 (+11 %) and 384 (+33 %), i.e. 17 % and 25 % fewer weight bytes per rank for a decode phase that is bound on expert weight streaming. The hidden size follows the intermediate alignment, exactly as the CK W4A16 SiTU/SILU carve-out does. Scope is deliberately narrow, mirroring that carve-out: only the W4A16 Triton backend, only SiTU/SILU (gpt-oss' SwigluOAI shapes stay as validated), and only gfx942. gfx950 keeps 256 because its CDNA4 scale swizzle requires BLOCK_K % 256 == 0. Move the backend's row out of the hardware-dependent round-up table into a test that mocks the CDNA generation, so both arms are pinned on every ROCm host. Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 ## Test `pytest tests/kernels/moe/test_ocp_mx_moe.py -k round_up` pins both arms (gfx942 -> 128, gfx950 -> 256) with the CDNA generation mocked, so the rule is checked on every ROCm host. End to end on MI300X (vLLM 0.31.1rc1, 2x TP4, agentic decode workload): 17 % (TP4) / 25 % (TP8) fewer expert-weight bytes streamed per rank; numerics unchanged (the padded columns are zero weights with zero scales). 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) --- Need help on this PR? This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

Thanks for the PR! Could you add a bench serve sweep against main on gfx942 for the TP4 and TP8 runs at a few concs and report the result? Would be great if you could add the serve cmd in the PR description too. Could you also run GPQA against main to verify accuracy?

The comment says the only hard alignment is the 32-wide scale block, and 576 and 288 are already multiples of 32, but this still rounds them to 640 and 384, right? Could you run those gfx942 TP4 and TP8 shapes through `moe_gemm_a16w4` and compare them with the current 256-rounded path? The new test only checks the rounded sizes

@@ -2557,8 +2557,9 @@ def run(quant_config):
     ("AITER_MXFP4_BF16", "SWIGLUOAI", 384, 384, 512, 512),
     # Backends that stay on the generic ROCm 256/256 round-up.
     ("AITER_MXFP4_FP8", "SILU", 384, 384, 512, 512),
-    ("AITER_TRITON_MXFP4_BF16", "SILU", 384, 384, 512, 512),
     ("TRITON", "SWIGLUOAI", 384, 384, 512, 512),
+    # AITER_TRITON_MXFP4_BF16 depends on the CDNA generation; see
+    # AITER_TRITON_MXFP4_ROUNDUP_CASES below.
 ]
 
 
@@ -2600,3 +2601,70 @@ def test_rocm_mxfp4_round_up_hidden_and_intermediate(
         f"hidden {hidden_in}->{hidden} (expected {hidden_out}), "
         f"intermediate {inter_in}->{intermediate} (expected {inter_out})"
     )
+
+
+# (cdna_version, activation, hidden_in, inter_in, hidden_out, inter_out)
+#
+# The aiter Triton a16w4 kernel masks K tails (EVEN_K / MASK_K_LIMIT) and N
+# tails itself and only needs the 32-wide e8m0 scale block, so on gfx942
+# (CDNA3) the per-partition intermediate of the SiTU/SILU W4A16 Triton backend
+# is aligned to 128 like the CK carve-out above. gfx950 (CDNA4) stays on 256:
+# its CDNA4 scale swizzle requires BLOCK_K % 256 == 0.
+AITER_TRITON_MXFP4_ROUNDUP_CASES = [
+    # DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (hidden 5120, moe_intermediate 2304) at TP4 and TP8:
+    # 576 -> 640 instead of 768, 288 -> 384 instead of 512.
+    (3, "SILU", 5120, 576, 5120, 640),
+    (3, "SILU", 5120, 288, 5120, 384),
+    # An already 128-aligned shard is allocated at its real width.
+    (3, "SILU", 384, 384, 384, 384),
+    (3, "SITU", 384, 384, 384, 384),
+    # hidden_size follows the intermediate alignment, as in the CK carve-out.
+    (3, "SILU", 4480, 384, 4480, 384),
+    # Only for SiTU/SILU; SwigluOAI (gpt-oss) keeps the generic ROCm arm.
+    (3, "SWIGLUOAI", 384, 384, 512, 512),
+    # CDNA4 keeps the generic 256/256 round-up.
+    (4, "SILU", 384, 384, 512, 512),
+    (4, "SILU", 5120, 576, 5120, 768),
+]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "cdna_version,activation_name,hidden_in,inter_in,hidden_out,inter_out",
+    AITER_TRITON_MXFP4_ROUNDUP_CASES,
+)
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not ROCM_AVAILABLE, reason="ROCm is required for this test")
+def test_rocm_mxfp4_round_up_aiter_triton_w4a16_by_arch(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+    cdna_version: int,
+    activation_name: str,
+    hidden_in: int,
+    inter_in: int,
+    hidden_out: int,
+    inter_out: int,
+):
+    """Pin the AITER_TRITON_MXFP4_BF16 arm per CDNA generation.
+
+    The CDNA generation is mocked so the table is checked on every ROCm host
+    rather than only on the card the CI happens to run on.
+    """
+    import vllm.platforms.rocm as rocm_platform
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.activation import MoEActivation
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.oracle.mxfp4 import (
+        Mxfp4MoeBackend,
+        mxfp4_round_up_hidden_size_and_intermediate_size,
+    )
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rocm_platform, "get_cdna_version", lambda: cdna_version)
+
+    hidden, intermediate = mxfp4_round_up_hidden_size_and_intermediate_size(
+        Mxfp4MoeBackend.AITER_TRITON_MXFP4_BF16,
+        hidden_in,
+        inter_in,
+        MoEActivation[activation_name],
+    )
+
+    assert (hidden, intermediate) == (hidden_out, inter_out), (
+        f"CDNA{cdna_version} / {activation_name}: "
+        f"hidden {hidden_in}->{hidden} (expected {hidden_out}), "
+        f"intermediate {inter_in}->{intermediate} (expected {inter_out})"
+    )

         # weights and OOM.

+        # The aiter Triton a16w4 kernel behind AITER_TRITON_MXFP4_BF16 masks
+        # K tails (EVEN_K / MASK_K_LIMIT) and N tails itself, so its only hard
+        # alignment is the 32-wide e8m0 scale block, and its tuned configs
+        # stream K in 128-wide slabs. Align to 128 on gfx942 for the same
+        # reason as the CK carve-out: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (moe_intermediate
+        # 2304) is 576 -> 640 instead of 768 at TP4 and 288 -> 384 instead of
+        # 512 at TP8, i.e. 17-25 % fewer expert weight bytes per rank. gfx950
+        # keeps 256: its CDNA4 scale swizzle requires BLOCK_K % 256 == 0.
+        aiter_triton_uses_128 = (
+            backend == Mxfp4MoeBackend.AITER_TRITON_MXFP4_BF16
+            and get_cdna_version() == 3
+        )
+
         # matmul_ogs uses block_k=128 for MXFP4 on pre-CDNA4 GPUs.
         # CDNA4's F16xMXFP4 configuration uses block_k=256.
         triton_uses_128 = (
@@ -868,7 +881,11 @@ def mxfp4_round_up_hidden_size_and_intermediate_size(
